codePatterns: ATX closing hash trimming: trim trailing spaces, trim trailing '#', check preceding space (if no space, hashes are content), trim trailing spaces again
Arena migration works best as phased TDD: infrastructure -> parser types -> parser GREEN tests -> index types -> index GREEN tests
ArenaHashMap Send constraint: always check trait bounds before adopting arena-backed collections in types stored across async boundaries.
At MCP tool boundaries, clamp user-controlled numeric fanout params (e.g. top_k) before engine dispatch
Avoid cloning ArenaHashMap with bumpalo allocator — causes SIGSEGV. Return Vec<&T> of arena refs instead of Vec<T> when T contains ArenaHashMap
Benchmark ROI workflow: expose env-tiered controls (samples + doc counts), run synthetic_scale per tier, parse criterion estimates.json, and persist markdown report artifact for decision reviews

Benchmark real corpus: use MARKYMARK_BENCH_EPSTEIN for epstein path when running from worktree without fixture; MARKYMARK_BENCH_HEAVY=1 for 100 samples (RAM-heavy for index_docs_dir); keep baseline worktree for pre/post comparison
ChildGuard RAII for process cleanup in integration tests
CoreEngine trait in core, transport crates are thin adapters
Custom Semgrep rules can be verified with deterministic fixture scans + expected finding counts when semgrep test mode is constrained by CLI version
Deterministic sort by URI then range for stable output
DocumentIndex::from_ast borrows from parser arena: use arena_ptr + ptr::read + mem::forget when borrow checker blocks into_arena()
Drop read lock before async publish_diagnostics (deadlock prevention)
FULL text document sync (not INCREMENTAL) for v1 LSP

For RealmIndex cross-doc maps, treat Cow<str> as a deferred optimization unless self-referential ownership is explicitly implemented (e.g., self_cell/ouroboros); validate with alloc_count_index_100 baseline before revisiting
For criterion benchmark reporting, read mean point estimates from target/criterion/**/new/estimates.json and compute speedups from those canonical values
For cross-agent handoff, attach full CodeRabbit plain review (including codegen prompts) as beads comments on the owning task
For cross-document block ID indexing, store Vec<(uri, block)> in insertion order and keep lookup API stable by returning first match; add regression test before changing semantics
For embedding-backed document indexes without delete support, keep metadata map authoritative and filter stale vector IDs at query time
For gitleaks staged negative testing, use a synthetic token that matches built-in regex exactly (e.g., ghp_ + 36 chars)
For self-referential migrations on stable Rust, split work into Ast-first then index-layer tasks and land self_cell owner/dependent conversion in isolated checkpoints
Generated benchmark output files must be excluded from the corpus used to compute those same benchmark metrics
Hook scripts receive JSON on stdin, output JSON to stdout, use exit 0 for no-op on non-matching files
If aggregate stats depend on file reads, surface unreadable inputs explicitly instead of returning silent partial totals
If fuzzy starts_with metadata is derived via zip, guard query<=candidate length to avoid truncated-pair false positives
If partial ingest failures can occur, collect pending index metadata in temporary structures and commit atomically
In Zig AutoHashMapUnmanaged mutation loops, reserve capacity before retaining value pointers across getOrPut operations
Keep Semgrep rule scope high-signal by excluding tests/** and validating with repo-wide scan excluding dedicated fixtures
LSP Content-Length framing vs MCP line-delimited JSON — NEVER mix them
Plugin hooks use hooks.json with {description, hooks: {EventName: [{matcher, hooks: [{type, command, timeout}]}]}} structure
Range containment for nested XML document symbols
RealmIndex cross-doc lookups: use owned ResolvedHeading/ResolvedBlock copies, populate on add_document, clear on remove_document
Regex-extracted types (BlockId, etc.) should carry source Range from full_match for go-to-definition — use byte offset to line/char conversion (same pattern as wiki_links, markdown_links)
Run local SAST baseline (cargo audit, cargo deny, semgrep) before enabling new CI workflow to establish signal baseline
SIMD kernel pattern: @Vector(16, u8) for byte scanning, inline for over lanes for match extraction, scalar tail for < 16 bytes

Safe refactoring workflow for large file splits: (1) convert to module directory, (2) extract types, (3) extract helpers, (4) extract tests. Each step: edit→test→commit cycle maintains green tests throughout. Final validation: all tests pass + line count reduction verified
Security CI for this repo is advisory-only with continue-on-error on each scan job
Semantic-search MCP rollout pattern: extend core operation contracts first, then map runtime semantic hits to DTOs, then gate optional realm-stats enrichments with explicit request flags.
Single-pass stack tokenizer for XML extraction (not multi-regex)
Test files follow pass/fail counter pattern with colored output and exit 1 on any failure
Use a lightweight structural regression test (source-level invariant) to prevent reintroducing internal static-marked storage during multi-step lifetime migrations
Use bumpalo Vec::new_in(arena).into_bump_slice() for empty arena slice, not &[] — literal &[] is stack-local and causes UAF when returned
Use slugify(heading.text) for duplicate detection, not heading.slug
When cargo-deny config fails, validate against installed tool version schema before assuming policy error
When extraction has dual paths (e.g. extract_list_items vs collect_top_level_list_items), remove dead extract_* if Ast uses the arena-driven path; plan invalidation is allowed
When hardening lifetime safety incrementally, add compile_fail doctests first, then narrow public signatures to &self-bound lifetimes, and only then adapt downstream call sites
When harness active/archive state drifts from beads reality, reconcile by restoring in-progress feature to active.json and clearing premature archive entry before continuing implementation
When migrating wrapper types (e.g. Bump->DocumentArena), trace all ptr::read/mem::forget usage - pointer type must match the owning type, not inner type.
When response contract is byte-bounded, truncate strings by bytes with UTF-8 boundary checks rather than codepoint count
When teammate implementer crashes, reassign narrow-scope blocker to test-writer to preserve momentum
When writing bd --design content with markdown backticks, use heredoc file + bd update to avoid shell command substitution
Zig SIMD heading scan: detect newlines with SIMD, validate heading syntax with shared scalar function
c_adapter.zig: test { _ = @import(...); } pulls sub-module tests into the main test step without needing build.zig changes
convert/state/server module separation in markymark-lsp for testability
docs-vs-practice audit: read doc, find all struct/field types in codebase, compare systematically. Key: test Send/Sync implications before changing types.
lefthook command values containing colons/braces must be YAML-quoted to avoid parse errors
rmcp CallToolResult::structured and structured_error for MCP payloads

namingConventions.testFiles: test_<subject>.sh (e.g., test_hooks.sh) for bash; <handler>_tests.rs for Rust integration

projectSpecificRules: ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} is the standard variable for plugin-relative paths in commands
Checkpoint updates must include claude-progress, working-context, and memory layer persistence
Do not advertise semantic-search in list_tools unless semantic-search feature is actually enabled
Existing tests use set -euo pipefail - be aware this causes early abort on command failures in non-conditional contexts
Plugin directory is markymark-plugin/ with .claude-plugin/plugin.json manifest
Rust integration tests in tests/ are standalone crates — each file gets its own imports, no mod.rs needed
Shared test helpers must be duplicated in tests/ files (pub(crate) not accessible from integration tests)
Use exact count assertions (assert_eq!) not >= in rename/edit tests — >= masked a closing-tag rename bug
When running learners-only checkpoints, persist memory/progress/context files without forcing commit/push
require_marksman! macro for graceful test skip when marksman unavailable in CI

rustPatterns.context: Adding or modifying LSP/MCP transport behavior
rustPatterns.application: Define shared operation trait in core crate first, then make transport crate a forwarding adapter

rustPatterns.pattern: Tree-sitter cursor traversal for nested markdown lists
rustPatterns.application: Walk tree-sitter nodes with cursor, collect list_item nodes and recurse into tight_list/loose_list descendants

rustPatterns.pattern: rmcp structured error envelope for tool handlers
rustPatterns.application: Validate input first, map core failures by error kind, always return CallToolResult::structured_error

rustPatterns.pattern: Binary smoke test with RAII cleanup and protocol-aware framing
rustPatterns.application: ChildGuard kill on Drop, thread+channel for timeout (no tokio), Content-Length for LSP, line-delimited for MCP

rustPatterns.pattern: Dual-process LSP alignment testing with response normalization
rustPatterns.application: Normalize URIs to filenames, sort arrays by uri+range, classify as Match/Superset/Mismatch/ServerOnly

rustPatterns.pattern: Drop read lock before async publish_diagnostics
rustPatterns.application: Scope RwLock, collect results into local Vec, drop lock, then call async client method

rustPatterns.pattern: Startup-index runtime adapter for MCP transport
rustPatterns.application: Validate roots once, index at startup, skip unreadable docs, keep runtime execute() read-only
Create blocking beads issue, document APIs/patterns/pitfalls first, prefer retrieval-led reasoning

rustPatterns.pattern: Hybrid arena ownership for LSP/MCP dual-transport
rustPatterns.application: Per-document Bump for parsed content (re-parse = swap arena). Realm-level owned storage for cross-doc index lookups. hashbrown with bumpalo allocator for HashMap fields.

rustPatterns.pattern: Audit README claims against actual implementation before release
rustPatterns.application: Use Explore agent to verify features exist in source code. Check CLI --help for real flags. Cross-reference CI workflows. Remove aspirational claims or mark as upcoming.

rustPatterns.pattern: Alpha/prerelease tagging workflow with CI pipeline
rustPatterns.context: Tagging a release to trigger GitHub Actions release.yml
rustPatterns.application: 1) Quality gates in parallel, 2) Bump workspace + plugin.json versions, 3) Exact match (=) for prerelease cross-crate deps, 4) Branch + PR + merge (hooks block direct main push), 5) Tag main + push tag, 6) Monitor CI, 7) Verify release artifacts

rustPatterns.pattern: Version sync across Cargo workspace and plugin manifest
rustPatterns.context: Bumping project version for any release
rustPatterns.application: Update root Cargo.toml [workspace.package] version, all subcrate path dep versions (use = prefix for prerelease), plugin.json version, and verify with cargo check + cargo run --version

rustPatterns.pattern: Extract duplicated unsafe arena transmute into a single helper
rustPatterns.application: Use one arena_ref() helper with clear SAFETY comment instead of repeating unsafe blocks in each extract_* method

rustPatterns.context: Performance validation where both quick iteration and scale sweeps are needed
rustPatterns.application: Use MARKYMARK_BENCH_SAMPLES and MARKYMARK_BENCH_DOC_TIER for workload selection, then run a dedicated binary to execute benches and emit a markdown summary table

rustPatterns.pattern: Zig C ABI string transform tests assert UTF-8 byte length
rustPatterns.context: Validating C ABI functions that return written length as i32
rustPatterns.application: Treat return value as bytes written; for non-ASCII samples (e.g. café), assert byte count and output string together

rustPatterns.pattern: Add new Zig C ABI surface in exports_<domain>.zig and include via c_adapter comptime import
rustPatterns.context: Extending Zig FFI exports without further growing c_adapter monolith
rustPatterns.application: Create dedicated export module (e.g., exports_graph.zig), keep lifecycle/query tests near export code, and wire with comptime { _ = @import(...) } in c_adapter

rustPatterns.pattern: Semantic search ranking uses score-first ordering with deterministic tie-breakers
rustPatterns.context: search-symbols style fuzzy result ranking across many candidate symbols
rustPatterns.application: Sort by fuzzy score desc, then starts_with preference, then lexical order to keep stable and relevant output

rustPatterns.pattern: Session context compilation loads harness memory layers in parallel and writes a session-scoped context artifact
rustPatterns.context: Running initialization/checkpoint workflows where fast resume context is required
rustPatterns.application: Read features/procedural/episodic/learned memory together, then persist consolidated data to .claude-harness/sessions/{session-id}/context.json
